{{Quote|Centuries ago, my clan fought Revan when we invaded the Republic with the rest of the Mandalorians. It was our privilege to battle Jedi.|[[Ceta Farr]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Clan Farr''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan that fought against the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] when the Mandalorians invaded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] they resided on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. They were allied with a renegade [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as the [[Order of Revan]] who followed Darth Revan's teachings and believed him to have defeated the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] and secretly taken his place. They hunted the beasts in Dromund Kaas's forest to challenge themselves in battle.

During the [[war against Zakuul]], [[Yenko Farr]] and his three sisters fought alongside [[Mandalore the Avenger]] during the [[Raid on Darvannis]], but were killed during the assault on the Droid Factory.<ref name="KOTFE" />
